entities.name: Carl Grundström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Grundström is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Philadelphia Flyers of the National Hockey League (NHL). Grundström was selected in the second round, 57th overall, by the Toronto Maple Leafs in the 2016 NHL entry draft, and has also played in the NHL for the Los Angeles Kings and San Jose Sharks.
